name: College Lab Fire & Chemical Safety
description: Comprehensive safety audit for academic chemistry, biology, and engineering labs covering extinguishers, eyewash stations, exit paths, and chemical storage.
disclaimer: AuditLens is an assistive pre-audit tool. It does not certify legal compliance. Verify against institutional EHS guidelines and local regulations.

rules.title: Fire extinguisher is mounted and clearly visible
rules.evidence_needed: Visual segmentation mask, confidence >= 0.60, timestamp citation
rules.fix_text: Mount a certified Class ABC or CO2 extinguisher on the wall within 10 meters of chemical workstations.

rules.title: Emergency exit sign is illuminated and clearly visible
rules.evidence_needed: Illuminated green/red exit signage detected above all egress doorways
rules.fix_text: Install or restore emergency illumination on all lab exit path signs.

rules.title: Walkways and fume hood perimeters are free of blocking obstacles
rules.evidence_needed: Absence of boxes, carts, chairs, or chemical containers along the primary walkway
rules.fix_text: Immediately clear all lab carts, temporary boxes, and waste containers from main evacuation aisles.

rules.title: Lab egress aisle maintains minimum clear width of 1.0 meter
rules.evidence_needed: Optical measurement >= 1.0m calibrated via A4 visual scale
rules.fix_text: Reposition mobile benches and lab stools so at least 1.0m of clear walking width remains.

rules.title: Emergency eyewash station is unobstructed and visible
rules.evidence_needed: Eyewash station detected with zero obstacles within 1.0m approach
rules.fix_text: Clear any glassware, chemical bottles, or drying racks stored within 1 meter of the eyewash station.
